summary.business_type: Local service provider (Webagentur, service-area business, Ostschweiz CH, de-CH)
top_findings: Soft-404: unknown URLs return HTTP 200 with homepage content (index,follow)
No Cache-Control headers on hashed static assets (483 KB JS re-fetched every visit)
Duplicate title: homepage and /webdesign-ostschweiz target the identical query
Single 483 KB JS bundle, no code splitting; DCL ~2.6 s
quick_wins: Add Cache-Control immutable to /assets/ in nginx (5 min)
Add security headers in nginx (10 min)
Change homepage title to stop cannibalizing /webdesign-ostschweiz
Remove robots.txt Disallow for /impressum and /datenschutz (noindex already set)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All URL variants 301 to https://www; self-referencing canonicals on every page
Full prerendered HTML for every route (React SPA done right)
Valid sitemap.xml (11 URLs) referenced from robots.txt
Gzip enabled; TTFB ~93 ms; zero console errors

findings.title: Soft-404 on unknown URLs
findings.description: GET /does-not-exist returns 200 with full homepage HTML, robots index,follow, canonical to /. nginx SPA fallback serves index.html for any path.
findings.recommendation: Restrict fallback to known routes; return HTTP 404 with a dedicated error page for unknown paths.

findings.title: No Cache-Control on static assets
findings.description: /assets/index-*.js (483 KB) and CSS served without any Cache-Control despite content-hashed filenames.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: No HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or CSP; Server header discloses nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu).
findings.recommendation: Add HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy; server_tokens off.

findings.title: robots.txt Disallow conflicts with noindex
findings.description: /impressum and /datenschutz are both Disallowed and noindexed; blocked crawling prevents Google from seeing the noindex.
findings.recommendation: Remove the Disallow lines and rely on meta noindex, or make Impressum indexable for trust.

findings.title: Content-Type lacks charset
findings.description: text/html served without charset=utf-8 (meta tag compensates).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Unique, well-sized meta descriptions on all pages
Real prices published (CHF 890+) — strong for conversions and AI answers
Founder-led E-E-A-T: Kevin Schmid named sitewide with real client references
Local-intent pages for Ostschweiz, Wil, Toggenburg, Thurgau (650-1224 words/page)

findings.title: Duplicate title homepage vs /webdesign-ostschweiz
findings.description: Both use 'Webdesign & Webagentur Ostschweiz | Serviweb' — keyword cannibalization.
findings.recommendation: Give homepage a brand+offer title; keep the location page on the Ostschweiz query.

findings.title: No informational content
findings.description: All 11 indexable pages are commercial; no blog/guide content for top-of-funnel queries.
findings.recommendation: Add /ratgeber hub with 1-2 German articles per month targeting Ostschweiz KMU questions.

findings.title: Location pages share near-identical template
findings.description: ~850 words each with similar structure; body copy is localized but could converge.
findings.recommendation: Add locally unique sections (references from the town, directions, local partners).

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One H1 per page, unique per page
Titles 35-55 chars, descriptions 120-160 chars
BreadcrumbList on inner pages
All location pages linked from every page footer

findings.title: og:site_name missing
findings.description: OG tags otherwise complete incl. og:image (49 KB) and og:image:alt.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Sitewide graph: Organization, Person, Place, GeoCoordinates, OpeningHours, 4 Services with Offers
FAQPage on home and all location pages
BreadcrumbList on inner pages

findings.title: Root entity is Organization, not LocalBusiness
findings.description: Address, geo, and openingHours are present but under Organization, which is not eligible for local rich results.
findings.recommendation: Change to ["ProfessionalService","LocalBusiness"]; validate in Rich Results Test.

findings.title: No review markup
findings.description: No Review/AggregateRating despite real client projects.
findings.recommendation: Collect reviews; add AggregateRating once 3+ exist.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: TTFB ~93 ms
Gzip: homepage 74 KB -> 14 KB
Lazy-loaded below-fold images

findings.title: Single 483 KB JS bundle
findings.description: No code splitting; DOMContentLoaded ~2.6 s, load ~2.8 s, ~562 KB total transfer. Lab data only (no CrUX).
findings.recommendation: Route-based React.lazy splitting; audit heavy deps; enable brotli.

findings.title: No asset caching
findings.description: Same as Technical H1 — repeat visits re-fetch the bundle.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt with services, prices, regions, references, and answer-engine guidance
robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot
FAQPage schema; entity-rich prerendered content; prices in plain text

findings.title: No citable informational content
findings.description: AI engines cite guides and answers; the site only has commercial pages.
findings.recommendation: Same as Content M5 — publish German guides.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Descriptive alt text on all images
loading=lazy on below-fold images
Reasonable JPG sizes (53-109 KB)

findings.title: No modern formats or responsive sizes
findings.description: JPG only; no WebP/AVIF, no width/height attributes, no srcset. ~500 KB of images on /projekte.
findings.recommendation: Build-step WebP conversion, intrinsic dimensions, 2-size srcset.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Security headers (HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy) + server_tokens off

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Verify GSC + Bing Webmaster, submit sitemap

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: WebP images with dimensions and srcset
